purpose: Stable semantic contracts for P2-P6 so future implementation can expand without redefining meaning. This registry does not claim those P capability phases are implemented or validated.
knowledge_time_rule: Products distinguish valid/event time, record/revision time and information-available/as-of time when materially relevant. Backfilled knowledge may produce a retrospective revision but must not masquerade as what was known at the original time.
evidence_independence_rule: Raw record count, observation count, independent subject count and effective evidence volume are distinct; deduplication does not prove statistical independence.

P2.name: Context Attribution & Normalization
rules: NOT_IDENTIFIABLE is a valid result.
Contribution is association/model-conditioned unless independent causal evidence exists.
No adjusted value overwrites P1 observed value.
Future information and same-episode leakage are prohibited.

P3.name: Reference-condition Longitudinal Capability / Aircraft Twin
rules: Default interpretation is reference-condition longitudinal performance estimate; intrinsic wording requires additional independent evidence.
Aircraft-level and model-level statistics preserve independent aircraft counts vs episode counts.
Twin is a published capability read model, not a real-time flight-state mirror and not same-episode World truth.
Lifecycle/config/software/maintenance changes are explicit markers/segmentation inputs.

P4.name: Human-Machine / Individual Training Assessment
rules: Qualification, diagnostic competency and evidence are separate output layers.
SA evidence is bounded by observable P/A evidence and validated proxies.
Human-machine metrics do not become aircraft intrinsic capability.
Automatic and instructor judgments remain revision-traceable and separate.

P5.name: Team / Package / Mission Assessment
rules: Team score is not copied to individuals.
Team composition is retained for longitudinal interpretation.
Package/mission assessment includes cross-team objective/handoff/timing relations.
System/data factors are not automatically assigned to personnel responsibility.

P6.name: Forecast / Counterfactual / Closed Loop
rules: Forecast/counterfactual products are physically and visually separated from fact/replay products.
Recommendation requires explicit approval state and is not written back as historical truth.
Counterfactual assumptions and model refs are always visible.
Operational/tactical optimization remains outside the safety boundary.
